description: This file defines the 'Node' class, which manages hierarchical configuration data with properties of various types, supporting serialization and property access methods.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a configuration node with properties and hierarchical child nodes, supporting property retrieval and modification.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Default constructor, needed for XML encoding.

methods.name: Node
methods.description: Protected constructor initializing node with a prefix and parent map, reusing existing node if present.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string can be parsed as a numeric value.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a child node with the specified name.

methods.name: getIntProperty
methods.description: Gets an integer property value with a default fallback.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Gets a boolean property with default value.

methods.name: getBoolProperty
methods.description: Gets a boolean property with specified default.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a string property.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets an integer property.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a boolean property.

methods.name: setBoolProperty
methods.description: Sets a boolean property.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property with default.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a string property, defaulting to empty string.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the node's prefix (used by serializer).

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the node's prefix (used by serializer).

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration map.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the node.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a double property.

methods.name: getDoubleProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a double property with default fallback.
